desc: A rare crystal drake, four-legged small dragon, deep navy scales, pale violet crystal spikes along the back, two small wings folded, bright teal slit eyes. High quality 16-bit pixel art game pet, crisp pixels, right-facing 3/4 view, full body, dark violet outline, pixel cluster shading with clear light and shadow, palette of lavender, pale violet, cream, ivory and deep navy, no props, no background.
